title: Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
abstract: arXiv:2611.08273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate the problem of scaling safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) to massively parallel training regimes, where a large number of environments are exe- cuted with short rollout horizons. Although this setting improves data throughput and wall-clock efficiency, it creates a mismatch with constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), whose safety constraints are defined over full-episode cost returns. We address this mismatch by analyzing staggered environment resets as a phase-mixture distribution over short trajectory segments. This analysis charac- terizes the bias induced by phase coverage and motivates a phase-aggregated cost estimator that reconstructs episode-level cost estimates from short rollout batches. We further incorporate finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch into a constraint-tightening framework, yielding a scalable Safe RL method compatible with on-policy optimization. translated_title: 基于大规模并行加速的安全强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了将安全强化学习扩展到大规模并行训练场景的问题，在这种场景中，大量环境以较短的滚动回合长度被执行。尽管这种设置提高了数据吞吐量和实际运行效率，但它与约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）存在不匹配，因为后者的安全约束是定义在整个回合的成本回报之上的。我们通过将交错的环境重置分析为短轨迹段上的相位混合分布来解决这一不匹配问题。该分析刻画了由相位覆盖所引起的偏差，并启发了一种相位聚合成本估计器，可以从短滚动批次中重建回合级别的成本估计。我们进一步将有限样本不确定性和分布不匹配纳入约束收紧框架，从而得到一种与同策略优化兼容的可扩展安全强化学习方法。基于 MJX 的实现……
tldr: 该论文提出相位聚合成本估计器与约束收紧框架，解决了大规模并行短回合训练与全回合安全约束之间的不匹配问题，实现了可扩展的安全强化学习加速训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a phase-aggregated cost estimator and constraint-tightening framework to resolve the mismatch between massively parallel short-rollout training and full-episode safety constraints, enabling scalable acceleration of safe reinforcement learning.
